variables.name: EVENT_GET_BINARY_SIZE_DONE
variables.comment: Finished retrieving size of transparent EF; start loading.

variables.name: EVENT_READ_BINARY_DONE
variables.comment: Finished loading contents of transparent EF; post result.

variables.name: EVENT_GET_RECORD_SIZE_DONE
variables.comment: Finished retrieving size of records for linear-fixed EF; now load.

variables.name: EVENT_READ_RECORD_DONE
variables.comment: Finished loading single record from a linear-fixed EF; post result.

variables.name: EVENT_GET_EF_LINEAR_RECORD_SIZE_DONE
variables.comment: Finished retrieving record size; post result.

variables.name: EVENT_READ_IMG_DONE
variables.comment: Finished retrieving image instance record; post result.

variables.name: EVENT_READ_ICON_DONE
variables.comment: Finished retrieving icon data; post result.

variables.name: EVENT_GET_RECORD_SIZE_IMG_DONE
variables.comment: Finished retrieving size of record for EFimg now.

variables.name: EVENT_GET_EF_TRANSPARENT_SIZE_DONE
variables.comment: Finished retriveing record size of transparent file.

methods.comment:
* Get record size for a linear fixed EF
     *
     * @param fileid EF id
     * @param path Path of the EF on the card
     * @param onLoaded ((AsnyncResult)(onLoaded.obj)).result is the recordSize[]. recordSize[0] is
     *                 the single record length, recordSize[1] is the total length of the EF file
     *                 and recordSize[2] is the number of records in the EF file. So recordSize[0]
     *                 * recordSize[2] = recordSize[1].
